verdict.rationale: Ghostty keeps its user data, namely configuration, keybindings and themes, in user-managed config files. These can be split across multiple files via `config-file`, every key mirrors a CLI flag, and users can author their own themes. That implies portable, file-based settings with nothing locked in. There is no documented export feature, and the pack never states the config format is plain text. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export or portability statement, confirmation that config and themes are plain-text open formats, export of session or scrollback data, and independent corroboration of migrating away.
